name: yaseen-milkdown
description: Yaseen Docs: local markdown editor as an Electron desktop app (React + Milkdown Crepe renderer, main-process file layer)

scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w desktop && node tools/packDesktop.mjs --mac
scripts.desktop:build:win: npm run build -w desktop && node tools/packDesktop.mjs --win
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w desktop && playwright test --config desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts
